#!/bin/bash dict_conn_user='postgres' dict_conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $dict_conn_pass ]] then echo "Dict secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Dict Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi dict_database_psql_host_address='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com'
hrmn_conn_user='postgres' hrmn_conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-0c2e7d88-731d-4e37-9af3-435c54e71610' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $hrmn_conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi hrmn_database_psql_host_address='harmonizeddb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com'
DB="dccharmonized"
PGPASSWORD="$hrmn_conn_pass" pg_dump --create --dbname=$DB \ --host="$hrmn_database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ -U $hrmn_conn_user \ --format=d \ --jobs=10 \ -f hrmn_dump
PGPASSWORD="$dict_conn_pass" createdb $DB --host="$dict_database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" -U $dict_conn_user
PGPASSWORD="$dict_conn_pass" pg_restore --dbname=$DB \ --host="$dict_database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ -U $dict_conn_user \ --format=d \ --jobs=10 \ "hrmn_dump/"
